sn56.24:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || || 3.
sn56.24:1.3: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathabhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || sabbe te cattari ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || || 4.
sn56.24:1.4: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
sn56.24:2.2: Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || dukkhasamudayam ariyasaccaṃ || dukkhanirodham asiyasaccaṃ || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 6.
sn56.24:2.3: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam arahanto sammāsambuddhā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu ||
sn56.24:2.5: abhisambujjhanti || sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathabhūtam abhisambujjhanti || || 7.
sn56.24:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇiyo ti || || 2.
